workarounds.symptom: A task with `parse` in its chain does not finish its end while a request is still inside (with #3323)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(parse): stop the Tika thread at the end, even with an object open. Target files: nodes/src/nodes/parse/src/parse-instance.cpp, nodes/src/nodes/parse/src/parse.hpp, packages/server/engine-lib/engLib/store/testing/container.cpp. - **Why.** A request can outlive its pipeline (#2511). When the pipeline ends while such a request still has an object open in `parse`, the end of the node waits for its Tika thread, and that thread waits for the rest of the object's data or parses the object again, so the end neve... (Ref: https://github.com/rocketride-org/rocketride-server/pull/3337)

workarounds.symptom: llm_openai_api sends temperature: 0 on every call: Claude Opus 4.7 and later, OpenAI o3 and gpt-6.2-sol, and gateway deployments in front of them return an LLM error instead of an answer
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(nodes): llm_openai_api drops a temperature the endpoint rejects, and gets a Temperature field. Target files: nodes/src/nodes/llm_openai_api/openai_client.py, nodes/src/nodes/llm_openai_api/services.json, nodes/test/llm_openai_api/test_openai_api_temperature.py. - `llm_openai_api` sent `temperature: 0` with every request and had no setting for it. Models that run only at their own default (Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8, the Claude 5 models, OpenAI `o3` and `gpt-6.2-sol`) and gateway deployments in front of them... (Ref: https://github.com/rocketride-org/rocketride-server/pull/3368)

workarounds.symptom: Client: the "No authorization provided" error does not say what to set
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(client): say what to set when no API key was sent. Target files: packages/client-common/python/src/rocketride_common/__init__.py, packages/client-common/python/src/rocketride_common/env.py, packages/client-common/typescript/src/env.ts. - When the engine answers `No authorization provided` and the client sent an empty credential, the Python and TypeScript clients now add a `hint` to the `AuthenticationException`. The message and the exception class are unchanged. - The hint says: set `ROCKETRIDE_APIKEY` o... (Ref: https://github.com/rocketride-org/rocketride-server/pull/3195)
